title: Who's this?
setting: Evening at home. You're scrolling through photos on Aoi's phone together, and Hikaru spots someone they've never met.

lines.jp: {会社|かいしゃ}の{友達|ともだち}。{背|せ}がすごく{高|たか}いよ。
lines.en: A friend from work. He's really tall.
lines.hint: は〜が describes a feature: (友達は)背が高い = he is tall. The は part is dropped because you both know who you mean.

lines.jp: かっこいいね！ どんな{人|ひと}？
lines.en: He looks cool! What is he like?

lines.jp: すごく{優|やさ}しいよ。{料理|りょうり}も{上手|じょうず}。{毎週|まいしゅう}、お{母|かあ}さんに{電話|でんわ}してるよ。
lines.en: Really kind. He's a good cook, too. He calls his mum every week.
lines.hint: に marks the person on the receiving end: お母さんに電話する.

lines.jp: いい{人|ひと}だと{思|おも}う！ {今度|こんど}、{会|あ}いたい！
lines.en: He sounds lovely! I'd like to meet him sometime.
lines.hint: A noun needs だ before と思う: いい人だと思う.

lines.jp: じゃあ、{来月|らいげつ}うちに{呼|よ}ぶ？ {肉|にく}や{野菜|やさい}を{焼|や}いて、{一緒|いっしょ}に{食|た}べる？
lines.en: Then shall we invite him over next month? We could grill some meat and veg and eat together.
lines.hint: や gives examples from a longer list: meat, veg and so on.
lines.cue: invite · next month · grill meat & veg

lines.jp: いいね！ {他|ほか}の{写真|しゃしん}も{見|み}てもいい？
lines.en: Great idea! Can I look at the other photos too?
lines.hint: 〜てもいい？ asks permission casually; add ですか with people you don't know well.
